notes.natural: Marktbreit preserves the beams while the smallest window and trim detail stays soft. The jet scene has clean sky color and rounded dark transitions. Both exact-flat centers appear smooth.
notes.wire: The strip example keeps its strong parallel set, with weak crossing contrast below the exact target. The ellipse example has incomplete weak lines and looks close to the matched control.
notes.main: The sky stays visually smooth. Coarse crossings are coherent, with soft fine bracing and leaf tips.
notes.fine_cab: Both left crops remain largely unresolved. Transferred right diagonals remain clearest, with incomplete fine crossings in both displays and noise profiles.
